newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower, despressed by Astra.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower, despressed by Astra.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Tuesday, depressed by drugs major Astra that continued tumbling after presenting a lower than expected first quarter profit on Monday.
A fall in Ericsson added to the gloom.
The general index fell 0.61 percent to 2,618.89 in turnover of 7.76 billion crowns. The slide accelerated when the U.S. market opened.
"It seems as if Americans have become worried about what is happening here," a chief trader said. "Ericsson will present its report on Friday and there seem to be some worries."
Astra plunged 14 crowns to 306.5, adding to its 22 crown fall a day earlier. But the share was trading without a dividend of four crowns.
Analysts said they were concerned about weak European sales development of Astra's anti-ulcer agent Locec.
Engineer ABB presented first quarter earnings which lifted shares in its Swedish parent ABB AB by 3.50 to 91.
Car safety equipment company Autoliv rose one crown to 290 after releasing first quarter earnings in line with expectations.
